agents.name: Maya Allan
agents.title: Licensed Real Estate Broker
agents.bio: Maya Allan is the founder and principal broker of Mallan Real Estate. With over 15 years of experience in New York City real estate, Maya has built a reputation for integrity, market expertise, and exceptional client service. She specializes in luxury properties throughout Manhattan and Brooklyn, helping buyers and sellers navigate the complexities of NYC's dynamic real estate market. Her deep connections in the industry and commitment to personalized attention have made her a trusted advisor to clients ranging from first-time buyers to seasoned investors.

agents.name: Sarah Chen
agents.title: Licensed Real Estate Salesperson
agents.bio: Sarah brings over 10 years of experience in Manhattan real estate, specializing in luxury condominiums and co-ops on the Upper East Side. Her deep market knowledge and client-first approach have earned her a reputation for exceptional service. Born and raised in New York City, Sarah understands the nuances of each neighborhood and takes pride in matching clients with their perfect home. She is fluent in Mandarin, allowing her to serve the diverse international community seeking homes in Manhattan.

agents.name: Michael Rodriguez
agents.title: Licensed Real Estate Associate Broker
agents.bio: With a background in finance and 15 years in NYC real estate, Michael excels at helping investors and high-net-worth clients build and optimize their property portfolios. He's known for his analytical approach and keen eye for value. Michael holds an MBA from NYU Stern and brings a sophisticated understanding of market trends and investment strategies. His bilingual capabilities allow him to serve both English and Spanish-speaking clients with equal proficiency.

agents.name: Jennifer Park
agents.title: Licensed Real Estate Salesperson
agents.bio: Jennifer's passion for architecture and design brings a unique perspective to every transaction. She specializes in helping buyers find properties with character and potential, from pre-war classics to modern new developments. With a background in interior design and a keen eye for detail, Jennifer helps clients envision the possibilities in each space. She is particularly skilled at identifying undervalued properties with strong renovation potential.

agents.name: David Thompson
agents.title: Licensed Real Estate Salesperson
agents.bio: A Brooklyn native with extensive knowledge of the borough's many neighborhoods, David helps clients discover the perfect home whether they're looking in Park Slope, Williamsburg, Brooklyn Heights, or emerging areas like Bed-Stuy and Crown Heights. His local connections and market insights are invaluable for navigating Brooklyn's competitive real estate landscape. David is passionate about helping families find their forever homes and young professionals discover their first Brooklyn apartment.
